title: Z9.F infinite sum — Actual strong-proper rational family is absolutely summable
milestone_description: For every natural $n$ and $W\in\mathbb Q[X]$ with $2n+2\operatorname{natdeg}W\le9(n+1)-2$, the genuine positive weighted sequence is absolutely summable: $\sum_{k\ge0}|f_{n,W}(k+1)|<\infty$. No Even n premise is required. The actual simple-pole coefficient total is proved zero from the stronger degree gap; its simple-pole terms are grouped into convergent differences. There is no supplied summability or cancellation hypothesis. Strict properness alone is insufficient: $n=0,W=X^4$ gives the divergent harmonic sequence.
